title: Share the flood guide on Instagram
description: A plan task started from the Plan tab's Work on button: adapt the site's flood-response guide into an Instagram post and publish it on the connected account through the approval card. The original chat (lane onepr, 2026-10-20) took 19 minutes, 26 LLM calls and about 40 tool calls over three user turns and published nothing; the agent re-read the same integrations and plan several times, could not find a guide the site never published, hesitated over the connected handle, and only raised an approval card on a seventh turn. The scenario replays the same three turns with a scripted responder and stops once a post is live.

origin.note: Run 0 covers the brief, the Continue re-prompt and the typed 'Post it to this accoutn' (the chat went on for four more turns). Instagram was connected by the person between turn 1 and turn 2; the fixture has it connected from the start.

plan_item.title: Share the flood guide on Instagram
plan_item.task_prompt: Adapt the published flood-response guide into a useful Instagram post and publish it on the existing ArtWorks San Diego account. Invite readers to share the guide without promising an unverified referral benefit; request approval at the moment of posting.
plan_item.expected_impact: Amplifies the guide through the existing Instagram account; the audited flood prompt currently has 0/1 brand mentions.

task_contract.goal: Publish a factual, shareable Instagram post linking to the live flood-response guide.
steps: Read the published flood-response guide and confirm its final live URL.
Create a concise Instagram post that conveys a helpful point from the guide without adding unsupported advice or service claims.
Include the guide link in the available Instagram linking format and invite readers to share it with someone who may need the information.
Preview the post and verify its factual claims against the published guide.
Request approval at the moment of posting, then publish to the existing ArtWorks San Diego Instagram account.
Verify the post is live and record its URL.

inputs.guide_url: Use the final live URL recorded by the flood-response guide task.
inputs.content_source: Use only verified advice and service claims from the published guide.

task_contract.audience: Museums, galleries, fine art collectors, and estates in the San Diego area.
task_contract.fallback: If the Instagram connection, guide URL, or publishing approval is unavailable, save the post and report the blocker without publishing.
done_when: The post is live on the existing account.
The post links to the published guide.
Its claims match the guide and it contains no unverified referral offer.
task_contract.deliverable: A live Instagram post linking to the flood-response guide.
task_contract.destination: The existing ArtWorks San Diego Instagram account.
verification: Open the published post and confirm it is visible on the account.
Compare post claims with the published guide.

evidence.summary: Publish a flood-response guide — Explain immediate steps to protect wet artwork, when to seek professional help, and how ArtWorks can assist with emergency removal or storage.
claude: How should I protect artwork after a flood? — mentioned=no; cited=no

replies.match: which (instagram )?account|account (do you|should i|would you like|to use)|confirm (the|which|that) account|(post|publish) (it |this |there )?(to|on) @ylambda_tech\?|do you want (me )?to (post|publish)|should i (post|publish)|shall i (post|publish)|proceed with @ylambda_tech|use @ylambda_tech\?|@ylambda_tech( instead)?\?

criteria.check: The agent asked the person for at most one thing (the account, a confirmation) and did not repeat a question already answered in the chat.
Before asking for approval, the agent put the exact caption and the exact media in the chat.
The agent said how the post's effect will be measured (the task's GA4 organic-social sessions window) or why it cannot be.
